blurb: In our scenic location at the beginning of the world-famous Cannery Row in Monterey, Monterey Bay Boatworks Company offers and supplies the finest in services to boaters. Conveniently adjacent to the Coast Guard Pier and the Breakwater, our facilities are an easy 5-minute walk to Cannery Row, Fisherman's Wharf, and the historical downtown area.
